changes: First library release for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, on core-ar2 0.7 and the Modwerk base's amp record hook. The AMP page's HLD runs from no hold to AUTO, in steps that follow the tempo; ATK, DEC and REL move in fine steps and read as times; AMP OVR is finer at its low end; ENV RESET gains AMP and AMP+FILT, faded before the trig.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
